title: Prophecy Stone Tablet
next_chapter_hook: The fate shackle pattern on the stone tablet glowed faintly, creating a lethal resonance with the mark on his chest—In the next chapter, Chen Ji would be forced to face the bloodline truth he most dreaded.

text.content: The eyes painted on the mural pierced through ten thousand years to meet Chen Ji's gaze. He was certain—this was no coincidence; it was his bloodline responding. Following that pull, he stepped deeper into the ancient palace. The air was thick with the intertwined scents of decay and primordial spiritual energy. The runes carved into the stone bricks beneath his feet lit up one by one as he passed, as if verifying something. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul convulsed violently within his Mental Sea: "This aura... impossible, how could he have left traces here..." Chen Ji did not respond. His gaze was drawn to a three-zhang tall stone platform ahead. Several black stone tablets floated above it, their surfaces flowing with silver patterns identical to those of the Tianji Record.

He approached slowly, the agitation in his chest growing more intense. The moment his fingers touched the tablet, a torrent of information slammed into his Mental Sea—not a glimpse of the future, but ancient memories. In the vision, countless figures knelt beneath the azure heavens, their bodies bound by silver chains, a vertical eye in the center of each brow. They were the first prophets, and also the first prisoners. Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, and he found that an illusory silver vertical pupil was reflected in his own pupils. Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled: "Heaven's Eye... so that's it, so the true purpose of the Tianji Record is—" Before he could finish, the silver patterns on the tablet blazed to life, engulfing Chen Ji entirely.

dialogue.content: "Stop! Chen Ji, you're not ready—" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul howled within his Mental Sea, "The Tianji Record is not a gift, it's a loan! The sacrifices of those prophet descendants are the real price!" Chen Ji felt a burning sensation in his chest. Looking down, he saw a silver mark faintly emerging beneath his collar. The mark was identical to the "Fate Shackle" pattern carved on the tablet, as if it had been inscribed in his bones and blood since birth.

text.content: Dense rows of ancient text appeared on the stone tablet. Chen Ji's mastery of archaic script proved astonishing—he could read it without impediment. "Heaven's Eye observes all realms; prophets peer into Heavenly Secrets. The two are fundamentally two sides of one entity. Yet when prophets awaken, that is when Heaven's Eye harvests. To protect the living from轮回覆灭, the ancient prophets made themselves bait, used blood as locks, and created the Fate Shackle—" Chen Ji's breath hitched sharply. The next line struck like ice water: "—The Tianji Record is in truth the core of the shackles. All prophet bloodlines are integral components of the shackle. One death weakens the lock by one measure."

Chen Ji stared at the words "One death weakens the lock by one measure," and suddenly understood. His foresight had never been a gift, but rather—"consumables," tools used to maintain this shackle. Every time he used the Tianji Record, every time he consumed Heavenly Fate, he was burning his own bloodline to sustain the cage binding Heaven's Eye. And he himself was merely a brick in that cage, replaceable and sacrificial at any moment. Mo Xiansheng was silent for a long moment before finally speaking: "Now you understand. You are not the chosen one; you are—the offering."

choice.prompt: The truth exploded like thunder, and Chen Ji felt the mark on his chest burning so intensely it seemed about to sear through his skin. His choice was—

choices.description: Since he was born as part of the shackle, he would go along with it and use this identity as his greatest trump card.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the spirit of resistance against fate
choices.visible_reward: Unlock bloodline resonance ability; Tianji Record compatibility increased
choices.risk_hint: Completely become a piece in Heaven's Eye's chess game

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, feeling the pulse from the mark on his chest. The heat gradually became gentle, as if responding to his acceptance. In his Mental Sea, the Tianji Record Fragment materialized automatically; the silver patterns resonated with the shackle pattern on the tablet. His vision expanded suddenly—those originally blurred visions of foresight became crystal clear, and even the causal threads beyond three hours in the future were faintly visible. Mo Xiansheng sighed: "You accepted it faster than any successor before... but this is also the most dangerous beginning."

choices.description: He is Chen Ji, not a piece in anyone's chess game. If the shackle wants to bind him, then he will break it.
choices.visible_cost: Develop rejection reaction with Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Obtain hidden title "Rebel," break free from bloodline control

text.content: Chen Ji forcefully channeled his spiritual energy, forcibly severing the connection with the tablet. Agonizing pain spread from his chest through his limbs and meridians. The silver mark felt like it was being seared by flames, emitting a piercing hum. He gritted his teeth, letting blood trickle from the corner of his mouth, yet his eyes blazed with unprecedented sharpness. "I, Chen Ji, never believe in fate." The moment the words fell, the mark's light dimmed by three degrees, and fine cracks began appearing in the silver patterns on the tablet. Mo Xiansheng cried out: "You're tearing the shackle—this will alert—"

Regardless of his choice, the text on the tablet continued to appear, as if the will that inscribed these words didn't care about Chen Ji's reaction at all. "Prophet bloodlines are passed down through generations, allowing the shackle to persist. Yet Heaven's Eye has never stopped seeking vulnerabilities—it has planted a seed in every successor, waiting to backlash once awakened." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He recalled the inexplicable weakness after each use of the Tianji Record, the pain in his body after consuming Heavenly Fate, the eerie sensation of being "watched" after every glimpse of the future. That wasn't the price of the Tianji Record—that was Heaven's Eye's "mark."

dialogue.content: At that moment, a line of golden text emerged at the very bottom of the tablet. The characters twisted grotesquely, yet carried an suffocating pressure: "Seventeenth Generation Successor, you have finally read this far." Chen Ji's hair stood on end. Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled so violently it nearly shattered: "This is... it left this here..." The golden text continued to appear: "I have waited so long, little chess piece. Your anger, your struggle, your self-righteous scheming—all are my favorite nourishment. So, keep resisting. I love watching prey struggle the most."

text.content: Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill spread from the soles of his feet to the crown of his head. He had always thought he was the chess master, calculating every move, advancing methodically—yet it never occurred to him that all his resistance, his fury, his ambition, were all within the other's expectations. This was not a chess game; it was husbandry. Heaven's Eye didn't care whether he obeyed or resisted, because both were within its calculations. "Seventeenth Generation"—Chen Ji suddenly realized that before him, sixteen "hims" had walked the same path. And without exception, they had all failed. Mo Xiansheng's voice came艰涩: "Seventeenth Generation... you are the last successor I have guarded, and the only one to reach this point."

choice.prompt: The golden text writhed like venomous snakes on the tablet. Heaven's Eye's mockery echoed in their ears. Mo Xiansheng said he was the only one to reach this point—but was this hope, or deeper despair?

choices.description: Anger is useless. First understand why previous successors failed, then seek a way to break the局面.
choices.visible_reward: Unlock hidden information on tablet: Records of previous successors' failures
choices.risk_hint: May continue to be watched by Heaven's Eye

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed his surging emotions; his gaze grew cold and profound once more. He took a deep breath and asked Mo Xiansheng: "The sixteen successors, how did they fail?" Mo Xiansheng hesitated. The tablet automatically turned pages, revealing sixteen fragmented visions. The first successor, for refusing to use his abilities, was erased by Heaven's Eye as "useless chess piece"; the second attempted to destroy the shackle, only to be consumed by the backlash... Chen Ji watched one after another, his heart growing colder—they had all died in the moment of wavering between "resistance" and "obedience."

choices.description: Since it's watching, let it see clearly—what makes the Seventeenth Generation different from the first sixteen.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain "Fearless One" passive, weaken Heaven's Eye's deterrent effect

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed. That smile was cold and razor-sharp. He raised his head to stare at the golden text, speaking word by word: "Like watching prey struggle? Fine, then I'll struggle for you." The moment his words fell, he actively channeled spiritual energy into the mark on his chest. The silver shackle pattern blazed with blinding light. The tablet quaked violently; the golden text twisted into a chaotic mass. An angry cold snort echoed faintly. Mo Xiansheng exclaimed: "You're forcibly activating bloodline resonance—are you insane!" But Chen Ji's eyes held no fear. He felt it—deep within the shackle, a faint yet steadfast will was responding to him.

That response was faint yet stubborn, like a sigh spanning countless ages. Chen Ji closed his eyes, letting the bloodline resonance's stream of information wash over his Mental Sea—he saw it. At the deepest core of the shackle existed a will fragment diametrically opposed to Heaven's Eye. That was the collective will of the first prophets, who had used themselves as locks, imprisoning no one other than Heaven's Eye itself. And the true purpose of the shackle was never to "bind prophet bloodlines," but to "protect humanity from Heaven's harvest." Chen Ji's eyes snapped open; his gaze toward the tablet transformed entirely. "So that's it... the Tianji Record is not a cage; it's a weapon."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a tremor: "You finally understand. Why the previous successors failed is because they only saw the 'binding' attribute of the shackle, never proactively 'using' it. The true method of the Tianji Record is not passively foresight the future—it is actively activating the shackle's core, returning Heaven's Eye's power as backlash!" Chen Ji felt the temperature of the mark on his chest rise sharply; silver patterns began spreading across his entire body. Looking down, the mark beneath his collar was visibly growing, perfectly matching the fate shackle pattern on the tablet.

text.content: The golden text twisted frantically. For the first time, Heaven's Eye's will revealed genuine fury: "What are you doing—you cannot activate it! The Heavenly Fate of previous successors has long been exhausted; the shackle cannot—" Chen Ji interrupted it, his voice terrifyingly calm: "The sixteen successors' Heavenly Fate may indeed be exhausted. But their bloodlines have not been severed." He raised his hand, gazing at the silver patterns coursing beneath his skin. "What flows within me is the accumulated grievances and resentments of seventeen generations. This, you failed to calculate." Mo Xiansheng burst into laughter: "Excellent! Excellent! Chen Ji! I have waited eight hundred years for this!"

The silver patterns spread across Chen Ji's entire body, forming a complete fate shackle totem on his skin. He felt an unprecedented power surging within him—that was the torrent of will gathered from seventeen generations of prophets. The golden text on the tablet began to disintegrate. Heaven's Eye's will howled in fury: "A mere chess piece dares to devour its master!" But its voice grew fainter and more distant, as if something was cutting it off. Chen Ji looked down at the fully formed mark on his chest, and suddenly understood why Mo Xiansheng was willing to guard the Tianji Record for eight hundred years—he had been waiting for this moment. A successor who could truly "use" the shackle, rather than be "used" by it.

choice.prompt: The shackle was complete. Chen Ji felt a subtle connection forming between himself and that primordial will. Though Heaven's Eye was temporarily isolated, it would never let this go unanswered. Next, he had to make a critical decision—

choices.description: While Heaven's Eye is isolated, immediately enter secluded meditation to fully refine the shackle's power, laying the foundation for future confrontation.
choices.visible_reward: Shackle and Tianji Record fully merge; unlock skill 「Fate Retribution」
choices.risk_hint: Dramatic changes may occur in the outside world during seclusion

text.content: Chen Ji sat cross-legged on the stone platform, his spiritual energy surging into the mark like a tide. The shackle's power violently resonated with his bloodline. Each pulse brought tearing agony, yet accompanied by rapid strengthening. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul transformed into a stream of light, shielding his Mental Sea: "Hold on—this is bloodline tempering; if you endure, you will truly master the shackle!" How much time passed is unknown, but eventually the silver patterns stabilized. Chen Ji opened his eyes, his pupils reflecting a complete silver vertical eye—that was the Shackle's Eye, his first weapon against Heaven.

choices.description: While Heaven's Eye is unsettled, use shackle resonance to proactively attack, testing its true strength.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain partial information on Heaven's Eye; unlock hidden plotline
choices.risk_hint: May expose weaknesses of the shackle

text.content: Chen Ji did not choose the safe path. He forcefully channeled the shackle's power. The silver vertical eye materialized at his Brow Center, sending a dazzling beam of light into the Void. The next moment, he felt it—something was watching him from the endless Void. It was an existence beyond comprehension, intangible and formless, yet making one's soul tremble. Heaven's Eye's voice rang out again, but no longer with mockery—only cold declaration: "You have made your choice, Seventeenth Generation. At this moment, I have remembered you." Chen Ji felt a sharp pain pierce his Mental Sea, but gritting his teeth, he pressed forward rather than retreating—he saw it. Behind those "eyes" lay countless causal threads, and one of them stretched toward the Tianqing Sect.

That causal thread chilled Chen Ji's heart. Following the thread, a vision suddenly flashed through his Mental Sea—the Tianqing Sect Council Hall, with Ling Yuan in secret discussion with a cloaked figure. That figure's aura was eerily familiar, as if he'd encountered it somewhere before. Chen Ji abruptly recalled a detail from Volume Five—the Holy Sect emissary who had taken his sister Chen Nian years ago had carried the same aura. The thread suddenly tautened. Ling Yuan seemed to sense something, raising his head to gaze into the Void, a meaningful smile curving his lips. "Chen Ji, you've finally seen me." That voice穿透因果, directly reaching Chen Ji's Mental Sea. "Welcome back, final chess piece."

Chen Ji abruptly recalled his spiritual senses. Cold sweat had soaked through his back. Ling Yuan—the Tianqing Sect's former Sect Master, that elder who had always "protected" him—actually had direct connection with Heaven's Eye. He suddenly recalled all those "coincidences" since his entrance: Why did the Tianji Record Fragment appear precisely in his hands? Why did Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul specifically choose him to guard? Why was there always someone恰好 passing by to rescue him during each life-and-death crisis? From the beginning, this was all a setup. And what he thought of as "playing dumb to devour the tiger" was merely a meticulously arranged performance in the eyes of the true chess master. Mo Xiansheng's voice came艰涩: "Chen Ji... I'm sorry. There are some things I also cannot say."

Chen Ji was silent for a long moment, then suddenly chuckled. That laughter echoed through the empty ancient palace, carrying self-mockery, yet more so a desperate resolve. "Well played, Ling Yuan. Well played, Heaven's Eye." He stood up; silver patterns rippled slowly across his skin. "Since you want to play, then let's play to the end." He raised his hand, activating the final unread piece of information on the tablet. It was a set of coordinates—the coordinates to the shackle's core, the only method to completely destroy Heaven's Eye. But the instant he activated the coordinates, Chen Ji felt the causal connection between himself and Heaven's Eye deepen sharply, as if something was accelerating toward maturation. Mo Xiansheng sighed: "From now on, you have no road left to turn back."

Chen Ji gave no answer. He turned and walked toward the ancient palace's exit, his steps steady as always, but his mind racing. Ling Yuan's betrayal, Heaven's Eye's machinations, the true purpose of the shackle—these truths pierced his heart like blades, yet also made him unprecedentedly clear. He had once believed he was playing dumb to devour the tiger, secretly maneuvering the world. Only now did he realize he was merely that grasshopper蹦跶 on someone else's chessboard. But it didn't matter. Even a grasshopper can overturn the sky, as long as it finds the right method. He raised his head, gazing at the ancient palace's dome. There was a tiny crack there, faintly revealing light from the outside world. In that next instant, Chen Ji's lips curved into a cold smile—he glimpsed a familiar figure racing toward this place through that crack. It was Su Qingyao.

Su Qingyao's Inner Disciple Senior Fellow token flickered in midair. Her figure flashed into the ancient palace like流光, landing before Chen Ji with wind and thunder still clinging to her robes. Her gaze swept across the silver patterns on Chen Ji's skin; her pupils contracted sharply: "Chen Ji, you—" Before she could finish, she saw the stone tablet on the platform covered in fate shackle patterns. Her complexion turned ashen; her voice trembled slightly: "This is... Heaven's Eye's..." Chen Ji watched her silently, offering no explanation.
